_comment: Everything about you that the scripts need. /setup writes this from an interview — you shouldn't have to hand-edit it, but nothing stops you. Notion table ids live separately in pipeline/notion_config.json, written by notion_bootstrap.py.
_example_note: While this is true, build.sh refuses to build anything but the worked example. /setup clears it once you have your own identity in here. If you are filling this in by hand, delete the _example line.

regions._comment: Region drives the phone number on the résumé and nothing else. new-company.sh takes one of these keys. Use the ROLE's location, not where you currently are.

locale._comment: en-GB makes American spelling a FAIL gate; en-US inverts it; null disables the spelling gate entirely. Whichever you pick, be consistent — a page that mixes both reads as careless.

rank._comment: How /jobscan scores a posting out of 100. p_admission and fit are your judgement, supplied per posting; the rest are mechanical. Change these if your priorities differ — geography especially, which is personal.

sources._comment: Which discovery sources /jobscan sweeps. The Notion watch list is the spine and cannot be turned off. The other two are UK-internship-specific and login-gated — leave them false unless they cover your market.

queue._comment: How many To-apply rows one /resume-build run drains. Each role costs a real slice of a session; three is a deliberate cap, not a limitation.
